<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def piece_state(frame):
    a = frame.ascii.split('\n')
    # find piece: non-B non-g cells in row21 within cols 23-42
    cells = [(c,a[21][c],a[22][c]) for c in range(23,43) if a[21][c] not in ('B','g')]
    cols = [c for c,_,_ in cells]
    pat = {}
    for c, r21, r22 in cells:
        pat[c] = (r21, r22)
    return (min(cols) if cols else None, max(cols) if cols else None, pat)

print("before:", piece_state(current_frame))
for i in range(3):
    res = action(['LEFT'])
    print(f"after LEFT #{i+1}:", piece_state(current_frame), "res_done:", res.get('done'), res.get('level_completed'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
